seed.note: A minimal synthetic DataProcessor+Form built from scratch (not copied from a real distribution, which failed to round-trip on unrelated XDTO schema mismatches -- RowsPicture/Type properties on unrelated controls the source form also carried). One Page (Group=Horizontal, ChildItemsWidth=LeftWidest) wraps one GraphicalSchemaField (ReadOnly=true, no Title, Width=50, Height=10). Imported and re-exported by ibcmd 8.3.27.2214 itself.

proven_claims: A GraphicalSchemaField nested directly in a Page whose own Group is Horizontal and ChildItemsWidth is LeftWidest publishes neither Width nor Height, confirming the same suppression observed on native UT 11.5.27.75's DataProcessors/ИнтеграцияС1СОблачнаяКартаПрикладныхРешений.

The raw options tuple (fields[39] of the field's own tuple) still stores the same nonzero width/height numbers (50, 10) regardless -- the suppression is a platform XML-write-time decision keyed on the parent Page's ChildItemsWidth, not a different raw value.
non_claims: This minimal reproduction also suppresses Edit (unlike native UT's own broken field, which keeps writing Edit=false even when nested the same way). The two cases differ in more than nesting -- the real field also carries a ContextMenu, ExtendedTooltip and Events the minimal one doesn't -- and this fixture does not establish which difference (if any single one) is responsible. The writer deliberately does NOT suppress Edit based on parent_child_items_width; only Width/Height do. See the comment on the Edit branch in format_form_child_item_xml.
Only ChildItemsWidth=LeftWidest is proven to suppress geometry. Other non-default ChildItemsWidth values, or a UsualGroup (rather than Page) parent, are untested.
